title: SNCS Fitness Causal Pipeline
description: Release package supporting the manuscript "How Reliable Is a Causal-Analysis Pipeline? Evidence from a Synthetic Health-Fitness Dataset". The archive contains the executable SNCS workflow, derived input data, corrected numerical artifacts, manifest, and focused regression tests.
